patterns: Dominant shape: direct isotope -> use (P-32/Co-60 leukaemia, Na-24 blood flow, As-74 tumour, I-131 thyroid, Co-60 gamma).
Dating questions recur: C-14 for fossils/wood/bone; uranium-lead for age of Earth/oldest rocks.
APPSC asks single-fact items (radon for cancer therapy, BRIT = isotope technology, gamma rays carry no charge).
Trap: 'BARC' in APPSC Group-2 PYQs is the Broadcast Audience Research Council, not Bhabha Atomic Research Centre.
App MCQs go far deeper into facilities (ISOMED 2.0, KRUSHAK, cyclotron, variety counts) and statement formats than PYQs show.
